fields.description: Issue features an investigative exposé of conditions and alleged abuses of mental patients at the Miami Retreat (a county-supported facility), including discussion of treatment of charity patients and calls for public action and investigation. Additional coverage includes local political commentary involving city/county officials and legislative matters, discussion of proposed confidentiality of birth and death records by the county health officer, reporting on Miami’s international air traffic and shipments involving Pan American World Airways, and civic/community items such as a PTA carnival announcement and concerns over Biscayne Bay bottom lands.
